node.label: Reduced leukocyte arylsulfatase A activity
node.definition: Concentration or activity of the lysosomal enzyme arylsulfatase A (EC 3.1.6.8) as measured in leukocytes is below the limits of normal.

evidence.snippet: Metachromatic leukodystrophy: Reduced leukocyte arylsulfatase A activity [TAS]
